title: Open URL inside Loop
description: Performance / UX rule — Open URL inside a Loop launches an external handler on every iteration.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Opening a URL per iteration spawns many handlers/tabs and disrupts the user.
rule.remediation: Collect the targets and open once, or move the call out of the loop.
